name: Southwest ridge day
story: A fresh southwesterly behind the drizzle, the cloud lifting and breaking into bright cumulus: lift along every ridge facing the wind, a rough ride in the lee and on final into the valley strips.
forecast: Southwest 13-15 kt, gusting 22 over the hills. Moderate turbulence in the lee. Cumulus, base 1100 m. Easing at dusk; broken cloud at night.
